For those whose nature is established, there is no difference from being intervened — just as with the <s>pṛṣṭhya</s> and <s>abhiplava</s> [rites]. — (sattra: Kuṇḍapāyinām Ayana)
For indeed, the extraction or supplementation [applies only] to rites that have attributes. — (sattra: Kuṇḍapāyinām Ayana)
But the <s>Subrahmaṇyā</s> (invocation) [is performed] continuously throughout. — (sattra: Kuṇḍapāyinām Ayana)
Because the time [for its cessation] has not been determined, due to uncertainty here. — (sattra: Kuṇḍapāyinām Ayana)
Some [say] it is abandoned, since it is an attribute of the pressing and <s>upasad</s>. — (sattra: Kuṇḍapāyinām Ayana)
But since the rite has commenced, stopping without reaching the end is a fault. — (sattra: Kuṇḍapāyinām Ayana)

With the nine-fold [stoma] for a month; with the fifteen-fold for a month; with the seventeen-fold for a month; with the twenty-one-fold for a month; with the twenty-seven-fold for a month; eighteen thirty-three-fold [days]; ten days of the twelve-day [rite]; and the <s>Mahāvrata</s> (great observance) and the <s>Atirātra</s>. — (sattra: Kuṇḍapāyinām Ayana)
Those who undertake this sacrifice with the entire [ritual complex]. — (sattra: Kuṇḍapāyinām Ayana)
The <s>Ayana</s> of the Serpents. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
The <s>Go</s> (cow) and <s>Āyus</s> (life) [days are used] in a similar <s>stoma</s>. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
Six months in the forward order; six in the reverse. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
The <s>Jyotis</s> (light) twelve-fold <s>stoma</s> [is performed] in place of the <s>viṣuvat</s> (solstice day). — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
Those desiring radiance should undertake [this]. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
Those desiring offspring [should undertake] the three-year [session]. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
The <s>Gavām Ayana</s> (cows' year-session) [is] the first year. Then that of the <s>Ādityas</s>. Then that of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
There are four <s>tāpaścitas</s> (austerity-fires). — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
The small <s>tāpaścita</s> [lasts for] the first year, including the consecration and <s>upasads</s>. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
Its pressing months are four — the first, sixth, seventh, and last of the <s>Gavām Ayana</s>. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
The three-year <s>tāpaścita</s>. Its pressing [lasts for] a year. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)

Stated by [the rules of] the <s>Gavām Ayana</s>. <s>Jyotis</s>, <s>Go</s>, <s>Āyus</s>, <s>Abhijit</s>, <s>Viśvajit</s>, <s>Mahāvrata</s> — or one each of the twenty-four-fold [stoma days]. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
The twelve-year <s>tāpaścita</s>. Its pressing [lasts for] four years. The recitations follow the <s>Gavām Ayana</s>, by the same rule as before. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)

The thirty-six-year great <s>tāpaścita</s>. Its pressing [lasts for] twelve years. The recitations follow the <s>Gavām Ayana</s>, by the same rule as before. Or, the latter half may have twenty-two pressing months; the former, twenty-three. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
That of <s>Prajāpati</s> [lasts] twelve years. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
Nine years each with each [stoma]. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
With these same <s>stomas</s>, [the session] of the <s>Sādhyas</s> [lasts] a hundred years. Twenty-five years each with each [stoma]. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
With these same <s>stomas</s>, [the session] of the <s>Viśvasṛjs</s> (world-creators) [lasts] a thousand years. Two hundred and fifty years each with each [stoma]. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
[The session] of <s>Agni</s>. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
A thousand <s>Agniṣṭomas</s>. — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
This they call the 'thousand-pressing' (<s>sahasrasāvya</s>). — (sattra: Sarpāṇām Ayana)
Now the <s>Sārasvata</s> (Sarasvatī) [sessions]. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
They should be consecrated at the western bank of the <s>Sarasvatī</s>. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)

Having performed the consecration, <s>upasads</s>, and the opening [rite] right there, they should proceed along the southern bank of the <s>Sarasvatī</s>, sacrificing day by day at every <s>śamyāprāsa</s> (yoke-pin's throw distance). — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
The <s>yūpa</s> (sacrificial post) has a mortar-shaped collapsible base. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
The <s>sadas</s> (priest's seat) and <s>havirdhānas</s> (soma-cart sheds) have wheels. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
And the <s>āgnīdhrīya</s> (fire-kindler's shed) and wives' hall. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)

Standing to the south-east of the <s>āhavanīya</s> (offering fire), the <s>Brahmā</s> (presiding priest) should throw the <s>śamyā</s> (yoke-pin). Where it falls, that is the site for the <s>gārhapatya</s> (household fire). From there, the [ritual] layout [proceeds]. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
If it falls on uneven ground, having picked it up, they should lay out [the ground] on level [terrain]. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)

If [it falls] in water, they should offer a <s>puroḍāśa</s> (cake) to <s>Varuṇa</s>; a <s>caru</s> (porridge) for <s>Āpānnaputra</s> (son of the waters): 'Having stood with feet in the water — some approach, others come near.' From here onward, [the procedure is] the same for all. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
The <s>Ayana</s> of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
Repeating the first six months of the <s>Kuṇḍapāyins</s>' <s>Ayana</s>, they should proceed. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
And month by month they should undertake the <s>Go</s> (cow) and <s>Āyus</s> (life) [days]. <s>Āyus</s> on the odd [months]; <s>Go</s> on the even. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
Thus indeed [is] the first procedure. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
Now the second. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
They should be consecrated so that the <s>Atirātra</s> falls on the new-moon day. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
Having concluded the <s>Atirātra</s> on the new-moon day, on that very day, they should separate the calves of the new-moon <s>sāmnāyya</s> (mixed offering). — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)

Having traveled that fortnight with the new-moon [rite], they should undertake the full-moon limb. Having traveled that bright fortnight with the new-moon [rite], they should undertake the full-moon limb. Having traveled the latter [fortnight] with the full-moon [rite], on the new-moon day they should undertake the <s>Āyuṣa</s> (life) [day]. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
Thus repeating, they should proceed. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
The <s>Ayana</s> of <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
With the <s>Go</s> and <s>Āyus</s> [days]. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
The <s>Ayana</s> of <s>Aryaman</s> — with the <s>Trikadruka</s> [days]. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
The recitation for the <s>Sarasvatī-parisarpaṇa</s> (Sarasvatī circumambulation) has been stated by [the rules of] the <s>Gavām Ayana</s>. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
But the single-cup days are <s>Atirātras</s>. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
The <s>pṛṣṭhya</s> day [is] the fourth. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
Thus indeed [are] the procedures. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
Now the concluding rites (<s>utthānas</s>). — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
Having reached <s>Plākṣa Prasravaṇa</s> (the Plakṣa spring-source), [they perform] the concluding rite. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
They should approach the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath) at <s>Kārapacava</s> on the <s>Yamunā</s>. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
Having emerged, an <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering) to <s>Agni</s> for a desired [purpose], arranged according to the <s>Vairāja</s> [pattern]. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
At that [offering], they should give a horse[-related] and a human[-related] milch cow as [dakṣiṇā]. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
This indeed [is] the concluding rite. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
Or [they should give] a hundred bulls with cows, when a thousand [is required]. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
When there is the forfeiting of all property. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)

Or when the householder dies. But when there is [only] forfeiture, those who are concluding should conclude with a <s>Viśvajit Atirātra</s> (all-conquering overnight sacrifice). When the householder dies, [they conclude] with the <s>Āyuṣa</s> (life) [day]. With a cow, when a thousand [is required]. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
Thus [ends the section on] the recitation. — (sattra: Sarasvatī sattra)
Now the <s>savanīya</s> (pressing-day) [animals]. — (sattra: role of paśu)
The <s>kratu-paśus</s> (rite-animals) [are offered] throughout. — (sattra: role of paśu)
[An animal] dedicated to <s>Agni</s>, or to <s>Indra</s>-<s>Agni</s>. — (sattra: role of paśu)
Or [an animal] dedicated to <s>Agni</s> on [days with] the <s>Rathantara</s> as <s>pṛṣṭha</s>. — (sattra: role of paśu)
[An animal] dedicated to <s>Indra</s> on [days with] the <s>Bṛhat</s> as <s>pṛṣṭha</s>. — (sattra: role of paśu)
Or the elevenfold [animals]. — (sattra: role of paśu)
At the two <s>Atirātras</s> — the opening and closing — they should slaughter [them] all together; or [an animal] to <s>Indra</s>-<s>Agni</s> in the interim. — (sattra: role of paśu)
Or the elevenfold [animals] one by one, daily. — (sattra: role of paśu)
But one should not take fewer than the elevenfold. — (sattra: role of paśu)

If they should proceed with this animal-session, on the third day of the <s>daśarātra</s> (ten-day rite), thirty-two elevenfold [sets] are completed. Therefore, in this nine-day [period], they should slaughter the surplus animals. — (sattra: role of paśu)
The <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> (offering to <s>Viṣṇu</s>) [uses] a dwarf [animal] on the twenty-first [day]. — (<s>sattra</s>: role of <s>paśu</s>)

The <s>Aindrāgna</s> (offering to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>) on the thirteenth. The <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> (offering to all gods) on the thirty-third. The <s>Dyāvāpṛthivīya</s> (offering to heaven and earth) — a milch cow on the twenty-fourth. Its calf, [as] the <s>Vāyavya</s> (offering to <s>Vāyu</s>), on the forty-fourth. A barren cow for the <s>Ādityas</s> on the forty-eighth. A <s>Maitrāvaruṇī</s> (offering to <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>) [cow for] the <s>Avivākya</s> [day]. — (<s>sattra</s>: role of <s>paśu</s>)

A <s>Vaiśvakarmaṇa</s> (offering to <s>Viśvakarman</s>) bull at the <s>Mahāvrata</s> (great observance). An <s>Āgneya</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s>) [animal] at the concluding <s>Atirātra</s>. — (<s>sattra</s>: role of <s>paśu</s>)

Or they may complete the thirty-three-fold [stoma] with the eleven-fold [animal set] itself. At the <s>Abhijit</s>, <s>Viśvajit</s>, and the <s>Viṣuvat</s> (solstice day), there should be two animals. — (<s>sattra</s>: role of <s>paśu</s>)
Now the rules for the <s>sattrins</s> (communal session participants). — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
From the consecration onward, [there is] cessation of the ordinary ancestral and divine rites. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
And they should completely avoid going to the village. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
[They should avoid] running. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Open laughter. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Jesting with women. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Conversation with non-<s>āryas</s> (non-noble persons). — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Falsehood, anger, and wading into water. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Being rained upon. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
And climbing a tree or a boat. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Or a chariot. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Greeting a consecrated person. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
But a consecrated person [may greet another] during the <s>upasad</s> (preparatory offering days). — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Both [may greet each other] during the pressing [day]. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Those of equal accomplishment [should greet] the one who began earlier. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Or the one more heated [by austerity]. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
When all are equal, [precedence is given] according to age. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
[They should avoid] dancing, singing, and playing musical instruments. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
And other conduct contrary to the vow. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
And they should not let them hear [the call] outside the <s>vedi</s> (altar) and <s>sadas</s> (shed). — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Nor [should they interact with] menstruating women. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Nor indeed should [the sun] rise upon [them still sleeping], nor should [one] go [to sleep] at sunset. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
If any of these [prohibitions] should be violated by misfortune, one should recite: 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, are the protector of the vow.' — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Or, having confessed, one should seek an <s>upahava</s> (invitation to rejoin) from the others. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
One who has broken [the vow of chastity], having been purified with those very consecration materials by them, they should re-consecrate. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
At the time of the <s>Āgrayaṇa</s> (first-fruits offering), they should prepare the <s>savanīya</s> (pressing-day) [cakes] from the new [grain]. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
During the consecration and <s>upasad</s> (preparatory) days, they should draw [milk] from the vow-cow. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
These are their observances. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Milk [is their food] during the consecrations. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Having alternated the time of the <s>upasads</s>, the fourth [meal is] from the milking of one [cow]. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
The same amount with three dilutions; the same with two; with one, the same amount. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
On the pressing days, they should subsist on the remnants of the oblation. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)

Parched grain, gruel, <s>parivāpa</s> (husked grain), <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake), and the excess — whichever of these they desire, that they should prepare as a supplement. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Mixed milk from a cow not being milked [is used] for curd. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Or one may prepare a <s>soma</s>-related supplement — says <s>Śaunaka</s> — as much as they consider a bowlful. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
[It should be dedicated] to the <s>Viśvedevas</s> (all gods) — some [say]. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
To <s>Bṛhaspati</s> — some [say]. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Or all [offerings], at each pressing. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Or, having cooked [the food] elsewhere, they should re-place [it] on the <s>gārhapatya</s> (household fire) and observe [it as] the vow-food. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
Or other foods suitable for the journey, up to roots and fruits. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
They should sustain themselves with this and with the animal [sacrifice]. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>sattrins</s>)
We shall describe the distribution of that [animal]. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)
The two jaws with the tongue [go to] the <s>Prastotṛ</s> (leader of the chant). — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)
The hawk-[shaped] chest [goes to] the <s>Udgātṛ</s> (chanter). — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)
The neck and hump [go to] the <s>Pratihartṛ</s> (respondent). — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)

The right hip [goes to] the <s>Hotṛ</s>. The left [hip goes to] the <s>Brahman</s> [priest]. The right thigh [goes to] the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>. The left [thigh goes to] the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>. The right side including the shoulder [goes to] the <s>Adhvaryu</s>. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)

The left side [goes to] the attendants. The left shoulder [goes to] the <s>Pratiprasthātṛ</s> (deputy adhvaryu). The right foreleg [goes to] the <s>Neṣṭṛ</s>. The left [foreleg goes to] the <s>Potṛ</s>. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)

The right thigh [goes to] the <s>Acchāvāka</s>. The left [thigh goes to] the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> (fire-tender). The right arm [goes to] the <s>Ātreya</s>. The left [arm goes to] the <s>Sadasya</s> (member of the assembly). The spine and backbone [go to] the householder. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)
The right feet [go to] the householder's vow-giving [priest]. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)

The left feet [go to] the wife of the householder's vow-giving [priest]. The lip [portion] is shared between the two of them; the householder himself should distribute that. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)
The rear portion [is] taken for the wives. They should give that to a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)
The shoulder vertebrae and three dorsal vertebrae [go to] the <s>Grāvastut</s> (stone-praiser). — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)

And three dorsal vertebrae and half of the <s>vaikarta</s> (dissected piece) [go to] the <s>Unnetṛ</s> (scooper). Of the two entrails-threads, three each [go to each]. And half of the <s>vaikarta</s> and the lung [go to] the <s>Śamitṛ</s> (slaughterer); he should give that to a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)
If [the <s>Śamitṛ</s>] is not a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)

The head [goes to] the <s>Subrahmaṇyā</s> (assistant). The hide [goes to] the one who announces the next day's pressing. The <s>iḷā</s> (refreshment portion) [belongs to] all. Or [it belongs] to the <s>Hotṛ</s>. These thirty-six single-footed [portions] carry the sacrifice. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)

The <s>Bārhatī</s> (Bṛhatī-related) [portions lead to] the heavenly worlds; thus, established in the vital breaths and in the heavenly worlds, they go [to heaven]. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)

This animal [distribution] leads to heaven when one distributes it thus. But those who [do it] otherwise — that is as if <s>Selagāvas</s> (a certain group) or evildoers would mangle the animal; such is that. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)

This distribution of the animal was made known by the seer <s>Śrauta</s>, [named] <s>Devabhāga</s> (god's portion). He indeed departed from this world without having proclaimed it. But the man [named] <s>Girijā Bābhravya</s> proclaimed it. From him, humans have since learned it. — (<s>sattra</s>: <s>paśu vibhāga</s>)

All [participants] should be of the same <s>gotra</s> (lineage) — [says] <s>Gāṇagāri</s>. For how could there be <s>āprī</s> (propitiatory) hymns? How could there be preliminary offerings? — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)
They may also be of different <s>gotras</s> — says <s>Śaunaka</s>, because the ritual systems are universally applicable. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)
The specific [ritual elements follow] according to the <s>gotra</s> lineage of the householder. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)
The success of all [depends on] his success. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)
But the <s>pravaras</s> (ancestral invocations) should be recited [for each], since [each priest] has the character of a participant. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)
The <s>Jāmadagnas</s> [and] <s>Vatsas</s> — their five-seer [pravara is]: <s>Bhārgava</s>, <s>Cyāvana</s>, <s>Āpnavāna</s>, <s>Aurva</s>, <s>Jāmadagna</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)
Now for the non-<s>Jāmadagnas</s>: <s>Bhārgava</s>, <s>Cyāvana</s>, <s>Āpnavāna</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)
For the <s>Ārṣṭiṣeṇas</s>: <s>Bhārgava</s>, <s>Cyāvana</s>, <s>Āpnavāna</s>, <s>Ārṣṭiṣeṇa</s>, <s>Anūpa</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)
For the <s>Bidas</s>: <s>Bhārgava</s>, <s>Cyāvana</s>, <s>Āpnavāna</s>, <s>Aurva</s>, <s>Baida</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)

For the <s>Yaskas</s>, <s>Vādhūlas</s>, <s>Maunas</s>, <s>Maukas</s>, <s>Śārkarākṣis</s>, <s>Sārṣṭis</s>, <s>Sāvarṇis</s>, <s>Śālaṅkāyanas</s>, <s>Jaiminis</s>, and <s>Daivantyāyanas</s>: <s>Bhārgava</s>, <s>Vaitahavya</s>, <s>Sāvetasa</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)
For the <s>Śyaitas</s>: <s>Bhārgava</s>, <s>Vainya</s>, <s>Pārtha</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)
For the <s>Mitrayus</s> and <s>Vādhryaśvas</s> — or a three-seer [pravara]: <s>Bhārgava</s>, <s>Daivodāsa</s>, <s>Vādhryaśva</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)
For the <s>Śunakas</s> — <s>Gṛtsamada</s> — or a three-seer [pravara]: <s>Bhārgava</s>, <s>Śaunahotra</s>, <s>Gārtsamada</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Bhṛgus</s>)

For the <s>Gotamas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Āyāsya</s>, <s>Gautama</s>. For the <s>Ucathyas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Aucathya</s>, <s>Gautama</s>. For the <s>Rahūgaṇas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Rāhūgaṇya</s>, <s>Gautama</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)

For the <s>Somarājakīns</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Saumarājya</s>, <s>Gautama</s>. For the <s>Vāmadevas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Vāmadevya</s>, <s>Gautama</s>. For the <s>Bṛhaduktha</s>s: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Bārhaduktha</s>, <s>Gautama</s>. For the <s>Pṛṣadaśvas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Pārṣadaśva</s>, <s>Vairūpa</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
Some cite <s>Aṣṭādaṃṣṭra</s>, passing over <s>Āṅgirasa</s>: <s>Aṣṭādaṃṣṭra</s>, <s>Pārṣadaśva</s>, <s>Vairūpa</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
For the <s>Ṛkṣas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Bārhaspatya</s>, <s>Bhāradvāja</s>, <s>Bāndana</s>, <s>Mātavacasa</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
For the <s>Kakṣīvats</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Aucathya</s>, <s>Gautama</s>, <s>Auśija</s>, <s>Kākṣīvata</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
For the <s>Dīrghatamasas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Aucathya</s>, <s>Daurghatamasa</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
For the <s>Bharadvājas</s> and <s>Āgniveśyas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Bārhaspatya</s>, <s>Bhāradvāja</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)

For the <s>Mudgalas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Bhārmyaśva</s>, <s>Maudgalya</s>. Some cite <s>Tārkṣya</s>, passing over <s>Āṅgirasa</s>: <s>Tārkṣya</s>, <s>Bhārmyaśva</s>, <s>Maudgalya</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)

For the <s>Viṣṇuvṛddhas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Paurukutsya</s>, <s>Trāsadasyava</s>. For the <s>Gargas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Bārhaspatya</s>, <s>Bhāradvāja</s>, <s>Gārgya</s>, <s>Śainya</s>. Or: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Śainya</s>, <s>Gārgya</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
For the <s>Haritas</s>, <s>Kutsas</s>, <s>Piṅgas</s>, <s>Śaṅkhas</s>, <s>Darbhas</s>, and <s>Bhaimagavas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Āmbarīṣa</s>, <s>Yauvanāśva</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
Some cite <s>Mandhātṛ</s>, passing over <s>Āṅgirasa</s>: <s>Māndhātṛ</s>, <s>Āmbarīṣa</s>, <s>Yauvanāśva</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
For the <s>Saṃkṛtis</s>, <s>Pūtimāṣas</s>, <s>Taṇḍis</s>, <s>Śambus</s>, and <s>Śaivagavas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Gaurivīta</s>, <s>Sāṃkṛtya</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
Or <s>Śāktya</s> is the root [name]: <s>Śāktya</s>, <s>Gaurivīta</s>, <s>Sāṃkṛtya</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)

For the <s>Kaṇvas</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Ājamīḷha</s>, <s>Kāṇva</s>. Some cite <s>Ghaura</s>, drawing back <s>Ājamīḷha</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Ghaura</s>, <s>Kāṇva</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)

For the <s>Kapis</s>: <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Āmahīyava</s>, <s>Aurukṣaya</s>. Now those who have double <s>pravaras</s> — such as the <s>Śauṅga-Śaiśirayas</s>: <s>Bharadvāja</s> says the <s>Śuṅgas</s> [and] <s>Katas</s> are <s>Śaiśirayas</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
Of those, one should choose from both sides — one from one side, two from the other. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
Or two from one side, three from the other. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
For there is no <s>pravara</s> of four [seers], nor an excess-<s>pravara</s> of five. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)
<s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Bārhaspatya</s>, <s>Bhāradvāja</s>, <s>Kātya</s>, <s>Ātkīla</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Aṅgirases</s>)

For the <s>Atris</s>: <s>Ātreya</s>, <s>Ārcanānasa</s>, <s>Śyāvāśva</s>. For the <s>Gaviṣṭhiras</s>: <s>Ātreya</s>, <s>Gāviṣṭhira</s>, <s>Paurvātitha</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Atris</s>, <s>Viśvāmitras</s>, <s>Kaśyapas</s>)

For the <s>Cikitas</s>, <s>Gālavas</s>, <s>Kālabas</s>, <s>Manutantus</s>, and <s>Kuśikas</s>: <s>Vaiśvāmitra</s>, <s>Devarāta</s>, <s>Audala</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Atris</s>, <s>Viśvāmitras</s>, <s>Kaśyapas</s>)
For the <s>Śraumatas</s> and <s>Kāmakāyanas</s>: <s>Vaiśvāmitra</s>, <s>Daivaśravasa</s>, <s>Daivatarasa</s>. — (<s>pravara</s>: <s>Atris</s>, <s>Viśvāmitras</s>, <s>Kaśyapas</s>)

For the <s>Dhanañjayas</s>: <s>Vaiśvāmitra</s>, <s>Mādhucchandasa</s>, <s>Dhānañjaya</s>. For the <s>Ajas</s>: <s>Vaiśvāmitra</s>, <s>Mādhucchandasa</s>, <s>Ājya</s>. For the <s>Rauhiṇas</s>: <s>Vaiśvāmitra</s>, <s>Mādhucchandasa</s>, <s>Aṣṭaka</s>.
For the <s>Pūraṇa-Vāridhāpayantas</s>: <s>Vaiśvāmitra</s>, <s>Devarāta</s>, <s>Pauraṇa</s>.

For the <s>Katas</s>: <s>Vaiśvāmitra</s>, <s>Kātya</s>, <s>Ātkīla</s>. For the <s>Aghamarṣaṇas</s>: <s>Vaiśvāmitra</s>, <s>Āghamarṣaṇa</s>, <s>Kauśika</s>. For the <s>Reṇus</s>: <s>Vaiśvāmitra</s>, <s>Gāthina</s>, <s>Raiṇava</s>. For the <s>Veṇus</s>: <s>Vaiśvāmitra</s>, <s>Gāthina</s>, <s>Vaiṇava</s>. For the <s>Śālaṅkāyanas</s>, <s>Śālākṣas</s>, <s>Lohitākṣas</s>, <s>Lohitas</s>, and <s>Jahnus</s>: <s>Vaiśvāmitra</s>, <s>Śālaṅkāyana</s>, <s>Kauśika</s>.

For the <s>Kaśyapas</s>: <s>Kāśyapa</s>, <s>Āvatsāra</s>, <s>Asita</s>. For the <s>Nidhruvas</s>: <s>Kāśyapa</s>, <s>Āvatsāra</s>, <s>Naidhruva</s>. For the <s>Rebhas</s>: <s>Kāśyapa</s>, <s>Āvatsāra</s>, <s>Raibhya</s>. For the <s>Śāṇḍilas</s>: <s>Śāṇḍila</s>, <s>Asita</s>, <s>Daivala</s>.
Or: <s>Kāśyapa</s>, <s>Asita</s>, <s>Daivala</s>.
'<s>Vāsiṣṭha</s>' — for those <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s> who are other than the <s>Upamanyus</s>, <s>Parāśaras</s>, and <s>Kuṇḍinas</s>.

For the <s>Upamanyus</s>: <s>Vāsiṣṭha</s>, <s>Ābharadvasu</s>, <s>Indrapramada</s>. For the <s>Parāśaras</s>: <s>Vāsiṣṭha</s>, <s>Śāktya</s>, <s>Pārāśarya</s>. For the <s>Kuṇḍinas</s>: <s>Vāsiṣṭha</s>, <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>, <s>Kauṇḍinya</s>.
For the <s>Agastis</s>: <s>Āgastya</s>, <s>Dārḍhacyuta</s>, <s>Idhmavāha</s>. Or if the last [is] <s>Somavāha</s>: <s>Āgastya</s>, <s>Dārḍhācyuta</s>, <s>Somavāha</s>.
For kings, [the lineage announcement uses] the <s>pravara</s> (lineage) of the <s>purohita</s> (royal chaplain).
Now, if they should announce [a lineage] of equal rank: <s>Mānava</s>, <s>Aila</s>, <s>Paurūravasa</s>.
Thus [end] the <s>sattras</s> (communal soma sessions).
Those [sattras] have no <s>dakṣiṇās</s> (sacrificial fees).
At their conclusion, a <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s> [is performed], a <s>pṛṣṭhya</s> (back-chant rite), for pacification.
[It has] a thousand as <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee).
Or another [amount] with a known <s>dakṣiṇā</s>.
'They should pacify with a <s>pṛṣṭhya</s> [rite] having <s>dakṣiṇā</s>s' — thus it is known.
This indeed is the reason — when there is natural existence, natural existence. Homage to <s>Brahman</s>, homage to <s>Brahman</s>.
Homage to the teachers, homage to the teachers.
Homage to <s>Śaunaka</s>, homage to <s>Śaunaka</s>.
Among the <s>Bhṛgus</s>, there is no intermarriage among the first four [sub-groups] with each other. The three beginning with <s>Śyaita</s> — intermarriage among them is permitted.
Among the six beginning with <s>Gautama</s>, intermarriage is not permitted with each other. <s>Dīrghatamas</s>, <s>Aucathya</s>, and <s>Kakṣīvān</s> are of the same <s>gotra</s> (clan lineage).
<s>Bharadvāja</s>, <s>Āgniveśya</s>, <s>Ṛkṣas</s>, <s>Śuṅgas</s>, <s>Śaiśiris</s>, <s>Katas</s> — these would be of the same <s>gotra</s>. Some say <s>Gargas</s> [are included] too.

<s>Pṛṣadaśva</s>, <s>Mudgala</s>, <s>Viṣṇuvṛddha</s>, <s>Kaṇva</s>, <s>Agastya</s>, <s>Harita</s>, <s>Saṃkṛti</s>, <s>Kapi</s>, and <s>Yaska</s> — intermarriage among these is desired, and with all others [such as those] beginning with <s>Jāmadagnya</s>.
As long as they are of the same <s>gotra</s>, <s>Viśvāmitra</s>'s [lineage] follows. Just so, <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, <s>Atri</s>, and <s>Kaśyapa</s> [follow] separately.

For those with two <s>ṛṣis</s> [in common], at the meeting of three <s>ṛṣis</s> — no intermarriage. For those with three <s>ṛṣis</s> [in common], at the meeting of five <s>ṛṣis</s> — no intermarriage.
<s>Viśvāmitra</s>, <s>Jamadagni</s>, <s>Bharadvāja</s>, then <s>Gautama</s>, <s>Atri</s>, <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, <s>Kaśyapa</s> — these are the seven <s>ṛṣis</s> (sages).
The offspring of the seven <s>ṛṣis</s>, with <s>Agastya</s> as the eighth — that is called <s>gotra</s> (clan lineage).

As long as even a single <s>ṛṣi</s> (sage) is shared in [two] lineage announcements, there is same-<s>gotra</s> status — except from the groups of the <s>Bhṛgus</s> and <s>Aṅgirases</s>. Thus, [when there is] non-identical lineage announcement, intermarriage [is permitted].
